name: Pizza at Resort 64
storyline:
Welcome to your temporary vacation job.

You've been hired to work for 7 days as a pizza maker at a secluded tropical resort. The job is simple: prepare pizzas, serve guests, and follow the routine until the end of the week.

The resort is beautiful, sunny, and perfectly organized. Maybe too organized.

And you do your job, because that's what you came to do.

During the day, you take care of the pizzeria.

At night, the resort allows employees to explore "lesser-known" areas of the island. Among them is a discreet building, hidden among artificial palm trees, and for some reason, you are taken there.

As the week progresses, the job stops seeming merely temporary. Small details begin to bother you. The silence between tasks lengthens. People's behavior changes. And the island, so welcoming at the beginning, starts to seem... something else.

Even so, it's only 7 days.

And you need to work until the very last one.
summary: Welcome to your temporary vacation job! Work for seven days as a pizza chef at a tropical resort that's too perfect to be real. Take care of the pizzeria, explore secluded areas of the island, and gradually realize that something in the routine isn't quite right.
